contract.mechanics_status: damage, taunt, armor dissolve, charges, and ownership remain owned by FAN-1483; this package binds frozen phase IDs only

generator_provenance.pixellab_usage: animate_image 9-frame stomp cycle for the homunculus_vial fusion avatar (FAN-2552) plus new transparent-frame animation sources via PixelLab MCP (create_1_direction_object + animate_object) for blast_powder (FAN-2550) and acid_flask (FAN-2551); no Chemist weapon reuses a static accepted asset any more

homunculus_vial.note: Accepted tank and caster sprites are reused for the fusion/split pair; the avatar now plays the FAN-2552 PixelLab stomp cycle whose frame 0 is the accepted ally_homunculus identity.

v2_presentation_reworks.decision: existing FAN-2550 PixelLab frames carry the v2 scale and length: slower beat spacing, arena-wide sigil scale-up, full-screen backdrop veil, hero glow highlight; no new PixelLab job required

weapons.title: Философский Взрыв
weapons.silhouette: arena-wide violet-gold pentagram with five multicolor alchemical charges at its points
weapons.motion_path: charges ignite during the cast ceremony, lock into a pentagram, freeze the arena at the impact beat, then the sigil sweeps outward and evaporates
weapons.timing_rhythm: 0.95s alchemical cast ceremony with the hero spotlit, one crystalline implosion into a hitstop-anchored gold-white flash at 1.3s, then a long visible recovery as the sigil evaporates
weapons.impact_language: one crystalline implosion into a gold-white transmutation flash that darkens and shakes the whole screen

performance.mechanics_owner: FAN-1483: normal pull/crystallize and finite transmutation damage
performance.v2_budget_note: FAN-2957 re-derivation: 5 drawn nodes (backdrop veil, hero glow, PixelLab frames, pentagram sigil, gold radiance) under a 6-node cap; one shared additive CanvasItemMaterial is the whole material budget, and the veil covers the screen in world space, so nothing draws in a screen-space layer

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: with the player's screen_shake setting off the driver holds the camera perfectly still instead of the impact shake, and the release flash plays as a calm fade — backdrop veil and gold radiance keep every beat at a damped peak
quality.flash_note: one non-repeating release flash at 0 Hz; WCAG general-flash threshold applies only to repeated flashes

weapons.title: Царь-Колба
weapons.silhouette: one colossal cracked flask flooding an irregular green acid lake
weapons.motion_path: flask tip pours forward, a wave expands outward, then pillars bubble from the lake
weapons.timing_rhythm: heavy flask reveal, broad flood, sustained bubbling pillars, then a slow evaporation
weapons.impact_language: corrosive flood, capped charge pillars, and evaporation smoke

performance.mechanics_owner: FAN-1483: permanent charge cap, armor dissolve, and encounter-bound lake lifetime

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: the acid lake keeps a calm static shoreline and slow bubble drift in place of the pour wave and pillar bursts

weapons.title: Совершенный Гомункул
weapons.silhouette: tank and caster fuse into one towering emerald homunculus
weapons.motion_path: two allies converge through a circle, giant avatar stomps, then both split back out
weapons.timing_rhythm: measured convergence, a long avatar action hold with beats, then a clean split
weapons.impact_language: taunt halo, broad stomp rings, and toxic cascade waves

performance.mechanics_owner: FAN-1483: taunt, stomp/cascade effects, and safe original-pair ownership restoration

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: the alchemical circle and taunt halo hold steady contrast rings and the avatar marks each stomp with a held brightness step instead of expanding rings
